name: dkv
description: Design review and direction for print and static graphic design — posters, flyers, packaging, labels, menus, signage, book and album covers, logos and wordmarks, slide decks, social posts. Says why something looks wrong and what to change. The design-fundamentals skill runs in two modes: CRITIQUE an existing piece against a structured review pass with impact-ranked fixes and per-finding severity, or DIRECT a new one with a proportioned palette (hex + 60/30/10 + measured contrast ratios), a type pairing on a modular scale, and a grid strategy. Carries the numbers most design advice omits (WCAG contrast floors for text AND non-text, the 45-75 character measure, 120-150% leading, the 8pt grid) and marks popular-but-unsupported claims (the golden ratio as a law of beauty, Baker-Miller pink, the 80% brand-recognition figure) rather than repeating them. Deliberately stops at the interface layer: websites, app UI, dashboards and components belong to impeccable / frontend-design.
